theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_mwc_lipschitz_smooth_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (L : ℝ≥0) (g : Eucl k → ℝ), LipschitzWith L g → ∃ G : ℕ → Eucl k → ℝ, (∀ m, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (G m)) ∧ (∀ m, LipschitzWith L (G m)) ∧ TendstoUniformly G g atTop ∧ ∀ᵐ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k)), Tendsto (fun m => fderiv ℝ (G m) w) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ g w))
